notes: Emberkin "Furnace Core" reactor: a gunmetal body in a riveted brass frame round a big arched furnace door full of live flame (4-frame flicker), four brass corner stacks with pilot lights chasing round, navy enamel plates north and south, pressure gauges east and west, and feed pipes. Damaged: the door ring dented with fire spilling out of the crack, the NE stack leaning and burning crooked, a gauge cracked. Disabled: cold ash in the door, the door buckled, a stack fallen, soot streaks. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
